checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is blob transaction blob count properly validated to enforce 1 <= count <= BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT?

reachability.notes: An attacker submits a blob transaction with zero blobs or exceeding MAX_BLOB_COUNT. The check prevents empty blob transactions and limits data availability overhead.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all entry points where blob transactions can be submitted (RPC, P2P mempool). 2. Locate the check_transaction function (SG-006) and verify it enforces: 0 < len(tx.blob_versioned_hashes) <= BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT. 3. Submit a blob transaction with zero blobs (empty blob_versioned_hashes array) and verify it is rejected. 4. Submit a blob transaction with exactly BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT blobs and verify it is accepted. 5. Submit a blob transaction with BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT + 1 blobs and verify it is rejected. 6. Check for off-by-one errors in boundary conditions. 7. Verify error messages do not leak sensitive implementation details.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0025, Source Invariant: SG-006/INV-005, Trust Boundary: tb-008. Pre-condition check for blob count range. Empty blob transactions waste block capacity. Exceeding MAX_BLOB_COUNT breaks data availability assumptions. Bug bounty eligible - PoC must demonstrate a blob transaction accepted with 0 blobs or > MAX_BLOB_COUNT blobs.
